title: EMERGENCY REQUISITION / GREAT CANAL CUT

left_card.title: CLIENT / HIGH STEWARDS
left_card.quote: The canal cut has bogged down in the silt basin. The ditch crews are refusing to dig without fresh rations.

right_card.title: OPPOSING PARTY / BOATMEN
right_card.quote: The boatmen will not deliver stone until the ration promise is entered and the timber tally is answered.
right_card.facts:
STONE DELIVERIES WITHHELD
TIMBER BALANCE DISPUTED

prompt: Your seal has a reputation at the landing. Settle this.

choices.label: Release emergency barley / bind the ration promise
choices.result_text: Fresh rations reach the ditch crews. The boatmen resume stone deliveries under a witnessed promise.

choices.label: Audit missing timber before authorizing delivery
choices.result_text: The missing timber is entered as a disputed balance. Stone may move under a provisional tally.

choices.label: Guarantee the crews' terms and break the strike
choices.result_text: The crews return to the cut. The guarantee is costly in reputation, but work resumes.
